interpretation: The failed examples remain intentional canonical aliases. They must keep one permanent redirect to a final 200 self-canonical URL and must not be present in sitemaps or internal links. A failed GSC validation is expected while those aliases continue to redirect and is not, by itself, a redirect defect.
recommendedGscAction: Do not restart Validate fix for intentional aliases. Inspect and request indexing only for the clean canonical destination when needed. Restart validation only for a URL that should return 200 directly but still redirects.
